paymentChange.title: Change payment details
paymentChange.materialWarning: This changes where money is sent. The account must be verified again before the next payment, and an approver must sign it off.

paymentPhone.title: Update contact phone
paymentPhone.info: The contact phone is used to reach the beneficiary about payments. Changing it does not move where money is sent, so no reason is required.

deactivation.title: Deactivate household
deactivation.permanentWarning: A permanent deactivation requires that no members are still active.
deactivation.searcherTitle: {count, plural, =0 {Never deactivated} one {# deactivation record} other {# deactivation records}}
deactivation.deceasedSingleMember: Deceased applies only to a household with a single member. For a larger household, deactivate the individual members instead.

audit.searcherTitle: {count, plural, =0 {No payment changes recorded} one {# payment change} other {# payment changes}}

banner.pendingUpdates: {count, plural, one {# update is} other {# updates are}} waiting for a decision{critical, plural, =0 {} other { — # need attention}}.

memberDeactivation.title: Deactivate member
memberDeactivation.deceasedWarning: Recording a death ends this person’s membership in every household they belong to and suspends their benefits. It can be reversed as a single action if recorded in error.
memberDeactivation.representativeInfo: This member represents the household, so a successor must take over the role.
memberDeactivation.successorRequired: A successor is required for each household this member represents.
memberDeactivation.searcherTitle: {count, plural, =0 {No active members} one {# member} other {# members}}
memberDeactivation.lastMemberWarning: This is the household’s only member. Deactivating them leaves the household without a representative — consider deactivating the household instead.
memberDeactivation.needSuccessor: Choose the member who will take over as representative.
memberDeactivation.needReasonText: Describe the reason in at least 10 characters.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this household?
deactivate.message: The household stops receiving payments until it is reactivated. Reason: {reason}.
deactivate.permanentMessage: This is a permanent deactivation for reason {reason}. It is only allowed when no members are still active.

deactivateMember.title: Deactivate this member?
deactivateMember.message: {name} will no longer be an active member of this household.
deactivateMember.deceasedMessage: Recording {name} as deceased ends their membership in EVERY household they belong to and suspends their benefits. It can be reversed as one action if recorded in error.
deactivateMember.personLevelMessage: {name} will be deactivated in {count, plural, one {# household} other {all # households}} they belong to.

reactivate.title: Reactivate this household?
reactivate.message: The household returns to its previous status and can be paid again. It was deactivated for: {reason}.

reactivateMember.title: Reactivate this member?
reactivateMember.message: {name} becomes an active member of this household again. They were deactivated for: {reason}.
reactivateMember.cascadeMessage: {name} was recorded as deceased, which ended their membership in every household. Reactivating reverses the whole cascade.

caseManagement.paymentChange.title: Correct payment details
caseManagement.paymentChange.materialWar: This changes where money is sent. The account will be re-verified with MUSE before it can be paid again, and the change needs a second person's approval.
caseManagement.paymentChange.accountNumb: Mobile money number (payment is sent here)

caseManagement.paymentPhone.title: Update contact phone
caseManagement.paymentPhone.info: A number for reaching the household. It needs no reason and no approval.
caseManagement.paymentPhone.notPaymentWa: This is NOT the number money is sent to and saving it will not re-verify the account. To correct a mobile money number, close this and use Correct payment details instead.
caseManagement.paymentPhone.contactPhone: Contact phone — not used for payment
